patterns.note: Main content is centered with generous vertical spacing between sections, creating an airy and structured feel.
Content sections frequently use an alternating image-left/text-right or text-left/image-right layout to break visual monotony and highlight specific brands or messages.
Prominent, decorative serif typography is used for all major section headings, establishing a sophisticated and editorial tone.
A warm, muted orange-red is consistently used as a primary accent color for decorative lines, section dividers, and the full-bleed footer background.
Subtle, decorative floral or starburst patterns are integrated as background elements or visual separators, reinforcing the brand's aesthetic.
No scroll-triggered reveal animations, parallax effects, or sticky elements are evident in the provided scroll sequence; the design relies on static hierarchy and clear section breaks.

technique_notes: The site employs a warm, off-white background with a strong, muted orange-red accent color for the footer and key decorative lines, creating a distinct and elegant brand identity.
Section titles are rendered in a large, decorative serif font, often centered, providing clear visual hierarchy and a sophisticated aesthetic.
Content blocks within sections utilize an alternating image-text layout, where images and text are positioned on opposite sides, creating dynamic visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, decorative serif headings (~3-4x body) with a more modest sans-serif for body text, creating a balanced but elegant hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most structural elements, with subtle rounding on some product image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major sections, with balanced spacing within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a warm, muted color palette combined with elegant, decorative serif typography and subtle floral background patterns creates a sophisticated and artisanal brand identity that feels more bespoke than a typical beauty site.
